children: US memory and storage supplier's Q3 revenue rose 149% yr/yr, driven by Samsung license fees
Gross margin improved to 65.5% from 4.4% on license revenue and higher product margins
Net income swung to profit from loss a year earlier
Company expects license revenue under Samsung and Micron agreements to continue
SAMSUNG LICENSE FEES - Co recognized $44.9 mln in license revenue from Samsung agreement in Q3
AI AND DATA CENTER DEMAND - Product revenue growth attributed to strong demand from AI and data center customers, per CEO
HIGHER MARGIN FOCUS - Gross margin improvement attributed to license revenue and focus on higher margin opportunities, per CFO
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the computer hardware peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Netlist Inc is $15.00, about 139.6% above its November 9 closing price of $6.26
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 25 three months ago
